name: emlyon business school
summary: Lyon business school; a four-year Global BBA with an English track and up to 75% abroad, and an English BSc in data science with Centrale Lyon.

ib.text: Open to students in their final IB year. Selection is online: your file and grades, then emlyon's digital tests and a recorded video interview.

programmes.name: Global BBA
programmes.about: A four-year management degree on the Lyon campus with an English track, exchanges and double-degree options, and up to 75% of the time abroad; work-study possible in year 4.
programmes.ib: Apply through the English pages to sit the tests and interview in English.
programmes.selectionNote: File review, then online tests (messages, avatar meetings, a written report) and a recorded video interview.

programmes.name: BSc in Data Science for Responsible Business
programmes.about: Run with the engineering school Centrale Lyon and taught in English: maths, programming and data science with responsible AI and business, on both Lyon campuses.
programmes.ib: Grades and English are assessed, then an online admission test; sessions run November 2026 to July 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: Competitive: school record, grades and English first, then emlyon's online admission test.

notes: International students admitted in the first session get 10% off tuition.
Selection runs in sessions until July; Global BBA 2027 session dates are not published yet; the data science BSc takes applications from early November 2026 to July 2027.
French-bac holders apply to the data science BSc through Parcoursup; an IB student applies on emlyon's own site.
